description: Open WebUI (GPU) is an extensible, feature-rich, and user-friendly self-hosted WebUI with NVIDIA GPU support for accelerated inference. It supports various LLM runners, including Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
name: open-webui-gpu
note: Requires NVIDIA GPU and nvidia-docker runtime. The GPU version uses the CUDA-enabled image for accelerated inference.
title: Open WebUI (GPU)
